reports.summary:
I-build has finished its work list. The audio-preferences flake (critic P1) has a root cause and a fix. The test plugin bank had no plugins.dat cache, so libvlc_InternalCleanup dlclosed every plugin. That was the silent stretch after "removing keystore memory": 1.5 s idle and more than 8 s under load. native-tests.py now runs vlc-cache-gen before any harness (C-bridge added this line to my file; it matches the shipped bundle). Shutdown now takes 33-48 ms, including under CPU load, against 1.5-1.6 s without the cache. The deadline stays at 8 s. The predecessor's diagnostics now compile in the real tree and run. Two compile/link breakages in the real audio suite are fixed: F-settings' half-done MXRAudioPreferenceServices.m was missing the vlc_plugin.h include, and harnesses had no vlc_module_name; they now get a weak one.

Other items:
- The per-window isReleasedWhenClosed contract is still green.
- No-op make evidence is recorded: the second make in a row left the archive, dylib and .la mtimes unchanged.
- Accelerate is autolinked from the Swift objects, so no Makefile.am flag is needed.
- lock.sh now takes MXR_LOCK_DIR.
- SCREENS.md is rewritten: the new preamble drops the CODEX_STATUS and codex/native-redesign citations and the outdated S62 text, and a new "Parity · live" column per S-id comes from finish/parity.json plus the live run.
- BUILD.md and WORKFLOW.md are updated.
- Dead code is removed (MXRCoreInfo with its one-line smoke test, and the redundant run-library-contract.sh).
- I added a positive control for DialogKeyLoopTests and confirmed with a mutation that it catches a Tab that is never delivered.
- --scheme light now works for shipping-window entries (rendered and checked).

Not committed (per the rules). Nothing installed. The full Swift runner was not run, only the targeted suites.
fixed: (d) Native audio flake, critic P1: cause found and fixed in the harness. There was no plugins.dat in the test bank, so module_EndBank dlclosed every plugin inside libvlc_InternalCleanup. tools/native-tests.py runs $BUILD/bin/vlc-cache-gen on the work plugin dir before any harness (C-bridge put this line into my file; I verified it and added a test). Phase markers show the step: with the cache, 'removing keystore memory' to 'libvlc_InternalDestroy' takes 35 ms; without it, 1588 ms. Evidence: ../build/evidence/final4/I-build/native-audio-{1,2,3}.log (33-44 ms), native-audio-load-{1,2,3}.log (34-48 ms under CPU load), nocache-load-{1,2,3}.log (1481-1599 ms). Deadline kept at 8 s.

(d) Deadline diagnostics (predecessor's half-done piece) are finished. The real audio-preferences harness now compiles with MXRNativeTestDiagnostics.h and prints [+ms] phases. On a miss it records the phase, the last engine log line and a sample call graph into MXR_NATIVE_EVIDENCE_DIR. tools/test-native-diagnostics.py passes (2 tests).

Two breakages in the real audio suite are fixed. (1) MXRAudioPreferenceServices.m (F-settings file, C-bridge's half-done command-line-options code) used CONFIG_CLASS/CONFIG_ITEM_* without <vlc_plugin.h>; I added one include line. (2) msg_Warn in bridge helpers needs vlc_module_name, which only the plugin descriptor defines. native-tests.py now links a weak `vlc_module_name = "macosx_redesign"` into every harness. contracts, build-runtime and audio suites all PASS: ../build/evidence/final4/I-build/native-{contracts,build-runtime,audio}-final.log

Regression test: test_audio_gate_indexes_plugin_bank_before_any_harness_runs in tools/test-native-runtime-isolation.py. It checks that vlc-cache-gen runs exactly once on work/plugins before any harness, and that audio-preferences gets VLC_PLUGIN_PATH=work/plugins and MXR_NATIVE_EVIDENCE_DIR=work. It fails on a copy of native-tests.py with the cache step disabled (checked through MXR_NATIVE_RUNNER).

Fixed test_media_provisions_discoverable_fixture_and_unique_marker: it assumed media-runtime was the last call, which broke when an effects-runtime step was added to the media suite. It now selects the media-runtime call explicitly.
(c)/(b) Per-window NSWindow isReleasedWhenClosed contract (predecessor): checked, and test-build-contracts.py is still OK with the new test file present.

(d)/(c) B-03 no-op make, mtime evidence under the lock: make1 relinked (the tree had changed); make2 and make3 rebuilt because other agents edited MXRServicesBridge.m and Swift files during the run (listed); make4 kept archive, dylib and .la at 1792192822/1792192823/1792192824. Only the always-invoked SwiftPM GEN line and plugins.dat regeneration ran. Evidence: ../build/evidence/final4/I-build/noop-make.txt and make-{1..4}.log

(d) Accelerate: verified with the real build under the lock (no install). The plugin links Accelerate.framework and libswiftAccelerate through Swift autolink (otool -L in noop-make.txt; the installed fae8f04dc0 plugin also shows it). No Makefile.am flag is needed; this is documented in BUILD.md section 6.

(f) lock.sh: the lock directory comes from MXR_LOCK_DIR (default ../build/locks/native.lock). It creates the parent directory, quotes paths, and adds status/path subcommands. Tested: acquire, contended acquire waits (timeout 124), release.

(d)/(f) SCREENS.md: the preamble is rewritten for claude/final. It no longer cites CODEX_STATUS.md or codex/native-redesign, and the S62 text now says local Lua install/enable/run works (D039/D045) and the catalog is not offered. HDR is Auto-only (owner). A new 'Parity · live' column on all 72 rows holds the worst offscreen verdict per S-id from finish/parity.json, with the owning area. Live results added: S01/S06/S17/S22 PASS, S05 FAIL (fullscreen top edge), S72 FAIL (Light bars, tint, video rescale), S12 NOT-RUN.

(d) BUILD.md: native-tests.py details (work dir and keep-on-failure, per-step timing, vlc-cache-gen and why, diagnostics header, MXR_NATIVE_EVIDENCE_DIR, weak vlc_module_name, the lock with MXR_LOCK_DIR), plus the measured no-op make and the Accelerate autolink note. WORKFLOW.md: deadline diagnostics, and the shared lock replaces the ad-hoc app.lock and points to wait-idle.sh.

(b) critic P2, dead code: the rescanPlugins path is already gone (no git grep hits in code). Removed the unused MXRCoreInfo (Sources/MXRCore/Foundation/MediaTime.swift, unowned) and its one-line-predicate test Tests/MXRCoreTests/SmokeTests.swift. Removed module/tests/run-library-contract.sh, a redundant wrapper around `native-tests.py --suite library`; the library-contract.m comment now points to that command and to make check-macosx-redesign-library. I scanned the other unowned Swift files for unreferenced declarations and found none.

(c) DialogKeyLoopTests had no positive control. New Tests/MXRUISnapshotTests/DialogKeyLoopControlTests.swift uses the same off-screen window, view stack and window.sendEvent Tab path without a dialog, and asserts that focus moves between two fields. It passes, and a mutation (no sendEvent) makes it fail. DialogKeyLoopTests and DialogKeyLoopGuardTests still pass.

(e) The --scheme light gap for shipping-window entries is checked and fixed (by A-window). Rendered S01.Window/shipping and S01.Window/pip in dark and light; the light renders show light bars and placeholder. Evidence: ../build/evidence/final4/I-build/scheme/{ship,pip}-{dark,light}.png

verdict.summary:
I checked every I-build work-list item on its own evidence and found no blocker or major. The only open points are minor.

**(d) Audio flake (critic P1)**
- Under the native lock I ran `native-tests.py --suite audio` 4 times in a row: 3 idle and 1 with 8 busy CPU cores. All passed. Engine shutdown took 35-54 ms against the unchanged 8 s deadline.
- `--suite contracts` also passed under the lock.
- This matches the fixer's measurements: with the plugins.dat cache shutdown is 33-48 ms, and in the uncached runs `removing keystore memory` to `libvlc_InternalDestroy` took about 1.5 s. So the root cause (no plugins.dat in the test bank, so cleanup dlcloses every plugin) is well supported.
- I ran a mutation in a copy (`MXR_NATIVE_RUNNER` pointing at a native-tests.py with the `run([cache_gen, plugins])` line removed). The new `test_audio_gate_indexes_plugin_bank_before_any_harness_runs` fails (`0 != 1`), so it is a real regression test.
- `tools/test-native-diagnostics.py` passes (2 tests). It covers the deadline-miss phase and sample capture.

**Per-window `isReleasedWhenClosed` contract**
- `windows_released_on_close` in `tools/test-build-contracts.py` now checks each construction against its own binding. It covers unbound constructions, local subclasses and a reused name, and it scans `Sources/` as well as `Tests/`. Its self-test includes the two-window case that slipped through before.
- All 8 tool test scripts pass (log in my evidence folder).

**No-op make, Accelerate, lock**
- B-03: `noop-make.txt` shows that make4 left the archive, dylib and .la mtimes unchanged.
- Accelerate: `otool -L` on the build-dir plugin lists `Accelerate.framework` and `libswiftAccelerate` with no Makefile.am flag. The only Makefile.am change adds the diagnostics test to the check target.
- `lock.sh` honours `MXR_LOCK_DIR`. I tested acquire, status and release on a temp directory.

**SCREENS.md**
- The preamble no longer cites CODEX_STATUS.md or codex/native-redesign, and the S62 text is updated (local Lua works per D039/D045; the catalog is not offered).
- I recomputed the worst offscreen verdict per S-id from `finish/parity.json`. Its 142 checks (70 match, 48 minor, 7 major, 17 not checked) agree with the "Parity · live" cell on all 72 rows.
- The live results match `live-run-1-window.json`: S05 FAIL, S72 FAIL, S12 NOT-RUN, S01/S06/S17/S22 PASS.

**BUILD.md / WORKFLOW.md** describe the new runner behaviour, the lock and the Accelerate autolink.

**Dead code**
- `MXRCoreInfo` and its one-line SmokeTests, and `run-library-contract.sh`, are removed.
- `git grep` finds no remaining references to them or to `rescanPlugins`.

**DialogKeyLoopControlTests**
- `swift build` is up to date.
- `swift test --filter DialogKeyLoop` passes all 5 tests, including the new control.
- The control drives the same `window.sendEvent` Tab path and asserts that focus really moves, so the isolation test is no longer vacuous.

**Rendering**
- I rendered S01.Window/shipping (shipping-window engine) in dark and light and compared them with Player-6. `--scheme light` now takes effect: light bars appear.
- Dark matches Player-6 apart from the documented traffic lights and title-bar controls.
- Light shows the video edge to edge with no 10 pt frame. This belongs to A-window (layout, possibly linked to the live S72 finding) and was already passed on to them.

**Rules**
- The engine is untouched: `git diff upstream-base-2026-10-14 -- src lib include modules/gui/macosx` is empty.
- No DECISIONS entries were written by I-build, and the Settings gate is untouched.
- The one edit outside ownership (a `vlc_plugin.h` include in `MXRAudioPreferenceServices.m`) is minimal and justified.

Evidence: ../build/evidence/final4/I-build-verify-r1/ (`audio-{1,2,3}.log`, `audio-load.log`, `contracts.log`, `tools-tests.txt`, `native-tests-mut.py`, `ship-{dark,light}.png`).

issues.description: The plugins.dat indexing runs only `if cache_gen.exists() and any(plugins.iterdir())`. If `$BUILD/bin/vlc-cache-gen` is missing (for example a partial build), the step is skipped without a word and the uncached shutdown stretch that caused the flake comes back. It should fail loudly, or at least print a warning, when the audio, media or fixture suites run without it.

The no-op make measurement (make4) is credible, but files changed during it (MXRAudioPreferenceServices.m, MXREffectsServices.m), so it is not a frozen-tree measurement. A no-op make also takes about 54 s of wall time (SwiftPM planning plus `qml.deps`), which is slow for an edit-build loop. The integrator should re-measure twice on the committed tree.

issues.where: Sources/MXRGalleryCatalog / shipping-window light render (A-window, not I-build)
issues.description: With `--scheme light`, S01.Window/shipping draws the video edge to edge with no 10 pt inset frame, while the dark render keeps the frame. This is an A-window layout difference, already passed on by the fixer and possibly related to the live S72 rescale finding. It is not caused by I-build files.

Rerunning gen_screens.py would regenerate SCREENS.md and drop the new preamble and the Parity · live column. The hazard is only documented in notes. Either port the column into the generator or put a guard comment at the top of SCREENS.md.
